questions.question: What is the authority limit above which a senior adjuster must decide? Is it a single amount, or does it vary by adjuster or product?
questions.why: Rules R3 and R9 and the refer_to_senior_adjuster action depend on it. The AUTHORITY_LIMIT placeholder is used until then.

questions.question: What amount counts as a 'small claim' that may be settled automatically? Is it the same as the authority limit?
questions.why: Automatic payment of money needs a stated limit. The SMALL_CLAIM_LIMIT placeholder is used until then.

questions.question: Is the decision deadline 5 working days or 10 days, and from which event does it run (submission or documents complete)?
questions.why: The brief states both deadlines, so the goal target cannot be set.

questions.question: Who may grant an exception to the document rule, on what grounds, and can the same person then assess the claim?
questions.why: Rule R2 needs a reviewer, and separation of duties depends on the answer.

questions.question: Who or what raises a fraud suspicion (adjuster, scoring system, both)? What happens after the investigation clears or confirms fraud?
questions.why: The flag_suspected_fraud action and the paths after referral depend on it.

questions.question: Must all three documents be present for every claim, or does the set vary by claim type (for example, photos not possible after total loss)?
questions.why: The completeness check and how often exceptions are needed depend on it.

roles.name: adjuster
roles.description: Checks eligibility against the policy and settles claims within their authority.

roles.name: senior_adjuster
roles.description: Decides claims above the authority limit. Proposed reviewer for document exceptions, pending question Q4.

roles.name: fraud_investigator
roles.description: Member of the investigation unit. Handles fraud referrals and records the outcome.

roles.name: claims_supervisor
roles.description: Inferred. Monitors decision deadlines and workload across claims.

agents.name: document_intake_agent
agents.description: Requests missing documents from claimants and confirms when the required set is complete.

agents.name: small_claim_settlement_agent
agents.description: Settles small, eligible claims with no fraud flag, strictly below the small-claim limit. It never acts on flagged or higher claims, and refers claims above the authority limit to a senior adjuster.

agents.name: fraud_routing_agent
agents.description: Sends every claim with suspected fraud to the investigation unit.

integrations.description: Reads policy coverage, status and limits for the eligibility check.

assumptions.statement: An exception to the document rule lets the claim proceed to eligibility assessment exactly as if documents were complete.
Claims between the small-claim limit and the authority limit are settled by an adjuster after a human decision.
A claim cleared by the investigation unit returns to the normal settlement path.
Settlement of a decided claim triggers a payment through a payments system.

unknowns: Value of the small-claim limit for automatic settlement.
Which decision deadline applies (5 working days or 10 days) and when it starts.
Who grants document exceptions and the criteria.
Source and criteria of fraud suspicion.
What happens to a claim after an investigation outcome.
Which systems hold policies, documents, payments and investigation cases.

understanding.summary: The organisation handles property insurance claims. The flow is: collect the required documents (photos, repair estimate, proof of ownership), with exceptions possible; an adjuster checks eligibility against the policy; small claims are settled automatically; claims above the authority limit go to a senior adjuster; suspected fraud always goes to the investigation unit. Every claim should be decided within a service deadline.
understanding.outcome: Every claim is decided correctly and on time, with automation only for small, clean claims and people deciding high-value, exception and fraud cases.
